versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

Initial release: a privacy-focused admin board template for organizing logistics during your first week at a new job.

- Lets you track access requests, forms, equipment, meetings, questions, deadlines, blockers, and follow-ups—while avoiding sensitive information like passwords, IDs, payroll, or HR data.
- Includes clear privacy boundaries and safe placeholders for sensitive actions.
- Provides structured board sections: snapshot, task lanes, access tracker, forms, equipment, meetings, questions, blockers, and end-of-week review.
- Designed as a prompt-only (no code) workflow for easy copy-paste and team adoption.
